rules.name: CVE-2026-59310 — VMware vCenter Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-59310: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.. Product: VMware vCenter
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where (Message contains "CVE-2026-59310" or Message contains "VMWARE VCENTER") | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
